items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: I don't know him. ... Arthur played with Tate Chambers.

ctx.x: A little Arthur? What else? Did he play any other instruments? No other instruments. Just clarinet? Yeah.
I don't know him. No, you know him. He is a little cross-eyed. Mm-hmm. Is he still alive? Oh, yeah. He's still alive. He's old. Arthur played with Tate Chambers. Sure he is old.
Oh, yeah. How old would Arthur be, I reckon?
